description: NSFW extra: Windah rages while hunting the portal ('portal-portalan, tai'), then the portal opens: 'portal itu nyata'. Cuts: T t 3085.00-3086.20 = local 0.60-1.80 -> output 0.00-1.20; A t 2763.30-2767.00 = local 3.00-6.70 -> output 1.20-4.90; B t 2775.30-2778.00 = local 7.90-10.60 -> output 4.90-7.60; C t 2959.90-2968.20 = local 11.80-20.10 -> output 7.60-15.90; D t 2972.45-2973.50 = local 21.30-22.35 -> output 15.90-16.95; E t 3060.50-3064.50 = local 23.55-27.55 -> output 16.95-20.95; F t 3099.95-3104.20 = local 28.75-33.00 -> output 20.95-25.20; G t 3110.90-3113.95 = local 34.20-37.25 -> output 25.20-28.25; H t 3133.00-3136.90 = local 38.45-42.35 -> output 28.25-32.15. NSFW EXTRA (raw swearing, police chase, user-approved): frame-0 teaser (h3 51:25, the portal ring, 1.2 s); the rage in stream order: 'anjing, gua ga ada armor lagi' (h3 46:04-46:07, the inventory screen) and 'portal-portalan tai' (46:15-46:18); 'bocil ini pagi nih anjing, sesat banget ... reaktor 2, reaktor 1 nih' over the map (49:19-49:28) and 'idiot, anjir' (49:32); then the reveal: he walks up to the ring (51:00-51:04), 'we did it bro, oh my god guys' (51:40-51:44), 'portal itu nyata' (51:51-51:54) and photo mode 'portal mengerikan itu nyata' (52:13-52:17). The raw swears are kept raw (like the posted 'segel'); the on-screen subtitles spell them out too, and the caption censors them. Word timings from faster-whisper medium; 'mana si portalnya bro' at ~46:03 was NOT picked up by the transcript, so the first 1 s of cut 2 has no subtitle: check by ear. BLURRED: cut 2 (the inventory menu with weapon icons: box source x620-1350, y40-800); cut 3 (the pistol he holds at the hip while running: box x620-1060, y700-1030, covers the lower body). CUT: the arrest at h3 49:34-49:45 ('jangan bergerak, hands behind your back'; the cut ends at 49:33.5), the weapon wheel at 46:00-46:03, the armed guards (42:36-43:33) and every spoken viewer name. Main 32.15 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Facecam-below layout (windah_recipe.py layout 'face'): gameplay = source crop 1504x846 at (0,0) scaled to 1080x608 at y364 (the corner facecam is outside the crop, no blur), Windah's facecam = source crop 352x264 at (1568,516) scaled to 520x390 in a 4 px Volt frame, centred at x276, y994-1392, clear of TikTok's bottom caption area and right icon column; hook line 1 Paper 'PORTAL-PORTALAN?!', line 2 Volt '...ADA, NYATA', Audex 68, bottom-anchored at y318; credit tag y326; subs at y905 over the lower gameplay panel. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
